[SWS_DM_01110] Callbacks for combined
UDS DTC
status change
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04200
⌈
Each time the combined DTC status has changed, the DM shall call all configured
callbacks.
⌋
The DTC fault detection counter is a signed value in the range between -128 and
+127. A positive value represents the situation that an
event
has been reported as
failed debouncing of a qualified failed is in place. For event combination the scenario
that an
event
is about to be qualified failed gets a higher priority than the scenario
that an
event
is about to be qualified passed.
